The statement reconfirms the existing diplomacy_refused context but does not represent a newly scored signal or probability change. Iran conventional risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.
sources: The Business Standard via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Trump calls U.S.-South Korea exercises ‘insulting’ to Kim Jong Un
reports.text: ABC News/AP reports President Trump called the exercises insulting to Kim while continuing to float a meeting this year. The statement reinforces an allied-posture reduction but does not activate a canonical signal: north_korea has no diplomacy indicator, and no missile-range or nuclear test was reported. Risk holds 24/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: Hamas official warns renewed Israeli escalation could collapse Gaza ceasefire
reports.text: The Palestine Chronicle reports Hamas Gaza leader Khalil al-Hayya warned that renewed Israeli escalation could collapse the ceasefire; IMEMC separately reported additional Palestinian deaths in Israeli attacks. These local-source claims reconfirm the already-active kinetic-breach context but were not independently corroborated in the fallback path. Risk holds 95/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Reports describe expanded U.S.-supported tanker corridor through Hormuz
reports.text: Seeking Alpha, The Jerusalem Post and The Times Australia report that U.S. military support has enabled a higher-volume commercial corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, while Reuters separately reported that traffic remained slower and uncertain. The reports reinforce controlled, non-zero passage rather than a verified normal reopening or zero traffic. Iran conventional risk holds at 95 raw / 100 coupled.
sources: Seeking Alpha via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Russian ballistic missiles attack Kyiv, mayor says
reports.text: Reuters reports Kyiv came under Russian ballistic-missile attack, citing the city mayor. The fresh strike reconfirms sustained high-intensity war but does not establish a distinct new configured threshold, official nuclear language or direct Russia-NATO exchange. Russia-Ukraine risk remains at the 99 ceiling.

reports.headline: Putin hosts Saddam Hifter amid Libya instability
reports.text: Al-Monitor reports Vladimir Putin hosted Saddam Hifter while Libya remains politically and militarily fragmented. The meeting is a material external-influence watch item, but no operational Russian force commitment or weapons package was independently verified. Libya risk holds 27/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Mossad chief and Syrian foreign minister discussed Turkish deployments before Israeli strikes
reports.text: Reuters reports, citing sources, that Israel’s Mossad chief and Syria’s foreign minister discussed Turkish military deployments before Israeli strikes on a Syrian air base. The report corroborates the existing deployed-force and infrastructure-strike context but does not establish a distinct additional force package. Syria/Idlib risk holds 25/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: United States provides $206 million for Gaza force despite deadlocked plan
reports.text: Reuters reports the United States is providing $206 million for a Gaza force even as the wider peace plan remains deadlocked. The funding is a material allied-position development, but it does not demonstrate ceasefire implementation or a new configured threshold. Israel-Palestine risk holds at 95/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Single public report claims Iran arrangement allows IAEA inspector access
reports.text: To Vima reports that an Iran arrangement allows nuclear inspectors access and attributes the point to the IAEA. Direct IAEA pages remained blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, and no retrievable official text or independent corroboration was found. The claim is logged as a de-escalatory watch item only; no canonical diplomacy or safeguards signal changes and risk holds 61 raw / 68 coupled.
sources: To Vima via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Iranian security-commission lawmaker threatens in-kind response to a U.S. nuclear attack
reports.text: Iranian parliament National Security and Foreign Policy Commission member Fada Hossein Maleki said Iran would respond in kind if the United States used a nuclear weapon, telling Khabar Online that ‘whatever the U.S. uses, Iran will respond to it.’ Türkiye Today, TRT World, Pakistan Today and Pakistan Observer independently reproduced the interview and explicitly noted that he did not claim Iran possesses a weapon. The official conditional nuclear-retaliation language activates nuclear_rhetoric_official; raw risk rises 56→61 and Iran-war coupling produces 68. No test, 90% enrichment or weapon possession is verified.
sources: Khabar Online interview via Türkiye Today

reports.headline: Canada raises Lebanon aid above $50m and condemns Israel’s “unlawful invasion”
reports.text: Canada raised 2026 Lebanon assistance above $50 million and its international-development secretary called Israel’s invasion unlawful while meeting Lebanese leaders. The statement adds allied diplomatic pressure but does not establish force withdrawal or ceasefire implementation. Fresh, separately reported Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon reconfirm ceasefire_violation; risk remains at the 95/100 ceiling.
sources: Canadian Secretary of State Randeep Sarai

reports.headline: Trump says he plans to meet Kim Jong Un this year
reports.text: Reuters reports President Trump said he plans to meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un this year. The statement is a diplomatic watch item, but the North Korea tracker has no corresponding configured indicator and no missile or nuclear test was reported. Risk holds 24/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: Russian drone attacks reportedly kill five in Ukraine's Kherson region
reports.text: The Hindu, citing Kherson regional governor Oleksandr Prokudin, reports that Russian drone attacks killed five people. Al Jazeera separately reported at least six deaths in Russian air attacks across Ukraine. The strikes reconfirm the active war but do not establish a new configured signal or a direct Russia-NATO exchange; Russia-Ukraine risk remains at the 99 ceiling.
sources: The Hindu via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Saddam Haftar reportedly meets Russian defence minister
reports.text: The Libya Observer's public-news index reports that Saddam Haftar met Russia's defence minister. The meeting is a material external-backing watch item, but a single indexed report without verified arms, deployment or operational commitments does not activate external_backing. Libya risk holds 27/CRITICAL.
sources: The Libya Observer via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Israeli strikes reportedly kill 11 in southern Lebanon
reports.text: Reuters-syndicated reporting, citing Lebanon’s health ministry, says Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon killed 11 people. The fresh kinetic breach reconfirms ceasefire_violation inside its configured window; diplomacy_active remains concurrent and raw/coupled risk stays at the 95/100 ceiling.

reports.headline: Brent reaches $91.88 as Hormuz disruption premium persists
reports.text: OilPriceAPI recorded front-month Brent at $91.88 and WTI at $85.02, respectively 36.3% and 33.3% above the configured pre-conflict baselines. The market remains consistent with severe Hormuz disruption but does not independently prove physical closure, attribution or a new military threshold; Iran conventional risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Gaza City police-station strike reportedly kills at least nine
reports.text: AFP via ABS-CBN and The Times of Israel report that Gaza health officials counted at least nine people killed in an Israeli strike on a Gaza City police station. The renewed kinetic breach activates ceasefire-breach evidence while the formal-talks offset remained unresolved; risk stays at the 95/IMMINENT ceiling.
sources: Los Angeles Times via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Israeli chief visits deployed troops after 100-person Syria raid and renewed Idlib strikes
reports.text: Anadolu, citing Yedioth Ahronoth and Syrian state reporting, says Israel’s chief of staff visited troops operating in southern Syria after a raid involving more than 100 personnel and 15 vehicles; eight airstrikes also hit the Abu al-Duhur runway. This activates military_buildup alongside infrastructure_strike and raises risk 20→25/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Houthis claim 31 operations against Saudi targets over past month
reports.text: Anadolu reports a Houthi spokesman claimed 31 operations from July 20 to August 19 against Saudi oil tankers, military deployments and energy facilities. Saudi officials had not commented by publication. The retrospective claims reconfirm existing indicators but are not independently verified and do not add a new score; risk holds 95/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: UAE suspends Iran trade and financial transactions after renewed missile threat
reports.text: Reuters and follow-on AP/public reporting say the UAE suspended trade and financial transactions with Iran after renewed missile fire or threat reporting. The economic rupture materially hardens allied pressure and reconfirms the existing ceasefire_violation context, but reporting on the attack details is contested and no additional canonical signal is activated. Iran conventional risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.
sources: Associated Press via The Globe and Mail and The Washington Post

reports.headline: UN says drone strikes hit El Obeid power infrastructure as displacement surges
reports.text: Official UN/IOM reporting says heavy fighting and drone strikes hit El Obeid’s main electrical transformer, prolonging outages and disrupting water, healthcare and communications. The UN says more than 200,000 people have been newly displaced across wider Kordofan since late 2025. infrastructure_strike activates; risk remains at the 99 ceiling.

reports.headline: ACLED sees intensified Houthi activity without a return to full Yemen civil war
reports.text: ACLED analysis indexed at 09:58Z says Houthi activity has increased in Yemen and Saudi Arabia but has not yet reignited the full civil war. This corroborates the already-active ceasefire_violation, infrastructure_strike and military_buildup indicators; it is analysis rather than a distinct new event, so risk holds 95/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Thailand’s chief negotiator seeks new path to revive southern peace process
reports.text: Reuters via the South China Morning Post reports Thailand’s chief southern-peace negotiator is seeking to revitalise talks, including possible decentralised governance and amnesties for BRN rebels. This activates diplomacy_active and lowers risk 30→27/CRITICAL; no ceasefire or reduction in armed capability is yet verified.
sources: Thailand National Intelligence Agency chief Thanut Suvarnananda

reports.headline: Reuters index reports first-stage Chinese work completed at disputed South China Sea reef
reports.text: A Reuters headline indexed by Google News says satellite images show China completed a first stage of work at a disputed reef. The linked publisher page was unavailable to direct fetch, leaving the scale and military purpose unverified. This is a high-priority watch item, not enough evidence to activate military_buildup; risk holds 35/CRITICAL.
sources: Reuters via U.S. News & World Report

reports.headline: Reports say Iran is weighing U.S. military targets in Europe if Washington escalates
reports.text: Financial Times and CNBC headlines report that Iranian decision-makers are weighing attacks on U.S. military targets in Europe if Washington escalates. This is conditional planning attributed through unnamed-source reporting, not a verified operational order and not a configured signal. It raises a next-watch trigger but does not change the 95/100 raw/coupled score.

reports.headline: South Korea and U.S. shorten Ulchi Freedom Shield exercise by nearly a week
reports.text: Anadolu, citing South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff, reports the allies agreed to end the ongoing exercise on Friday rather than August 27 and scale back some field training after a U.S. proposal. This is a verified allied-posture reduction, but North Korea has no configured diplomacy signal and no new missile or nuclear test occurred; risk holds 24/ELEVATED.
sources: South Korea Joint Chiefs of Staff

reports.headline: Kpler counts six Hormuz commodity-vessel crossings as traffic slows again
reports.text: Reuters reports six commodity vessels crossed Hormuz on 18 August, down from nine a day earlier and below the 10-day average of 11. President Trump said no U.S.-Iran talks were taking place. The data reconfirm hormuz_controlled_not_closed and diplomacy_refused, not zero traffic; raw/coupled risk holds 95/100.

reports.headline: Iraqi factions begin weapons handovers under state-control plan
reports.text: Iraq's Security Media Cell says several PMF factions have begun handing over weapons and others are moving in the same direction under legal arrangements to place arms under state control. Anadolu verified the statement through the state-run Iraqi News Agency. This crosses canonical diplomacy_active and lowers risk 53→50/IMMINENT; implementation breadth and durability remain unverified.

reports.headline: KRG confirms Iran used Hadid-110 jet drones in attacks on senior government premises
reports.text: The KRG Counter-Terrorism Directorate says Iran launched two explosive-laden Hadid-110 drones on August 17 at the regional prime minister's private office and the intelligence chief's residence. Direct article-body verification strengthens attribution and reconfirms the active infrastructure-attack indicator, but the event was already scored; risk is 50/IMMINENT after the separate disarmament move.

reports.headline: Libyan leaders discuss breaking political deadlock as UN warns security remains precarious
reports.text: Anadolu reports Prime Minister Abdul Hamid Dbeibah and the High Council of State head discussed ways to break the political deadlock. UN News, The National and the Libya Observer independently describe a precarious security environment. The distinct past-24h coverage clears the configured auto-detection gate; Libya is added at 27/CRITICAL with canonical diplomacy_active, and no fresh kinetic threshold is scored.

reports.headline: U.S. starts Israel-Turkey-Syria deconfliction push after near-miss over Idlib strike
reports.text: U.S. envoy Tom Barrack told Reuters that Washington is working to establish a deconfliction mechanism after Turkey was not warned of Israel's Abu al-Dahur airbase strikes and could have prepared a military response as aircraft headed north. Barrack said calm heads prevented further deterioration. This reinforces Turkey's active diplomacy indicator; no configured missile or nuclear threshold changed and risk holds 5/DETERRENT.

reports.headline: North Korea condemns allied drills despite U.S. scale-back order
reports.text: Reuters was indexed reporting that North Korea condemned U.S.-South Korea drills despite President Trump’s order to scale them back. The source body was access-blocked in the fallback path. No fresh DPRK missile or nuclear test was reported, so no configured signal changes and risk holds 24/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: Austria opens direct Iran channel and presses for diplomacy and IAEA-inclusive nuclear talks
reports.text: Austria’s foreign minister said she called Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi to urge diplomatic stabilization, freedom of navigation in Hormuz and a nuclear agreement fully involving the IAEA. Iran cited its talks with Oman. This reinforces the already-active diplomatic channel but does not establish direct U.S.-Iran talks or a signed framework; risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Kpler revision shows limited Hormuz traffic as Iran keeps reopening conditional
reports.text: AP reports Kpler counted 95 Hormuz transits last week and three on Sunday, all through the Iranian-designated route, superseding the earlier zero-transit report. Iran says full reopening remains conditional while President Trump says no direct Iran talks are planned. AP also reports the UAE said two Iranian ballistic missiles fell at sea and were assessed as targeting maritime traffic. Canonical hormuz_controlled_not_closed activates, hormuz_zero_traffic deactivates, and ceasefire_violation is reconfirmed; risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.
sources: Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf

The market remains consistent with severe Hormuz disruption but does not independently prove physical closure, attribution or a new military threshold; risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: UKMTO reports cargo vessel a total loss off Yemen; Houthi refinery claim remains unconfirmed
reports.text: AP reports UKMTO assessed a cargo vessel hit about 40 nautical miles southeast of Mokha as a constructive total loss. The Houthis separately claimed drones targeted a Saudi Aramco refinery, but Saudi Arabia had reported no damage or response by cutoff. The vessel loss reconfirms the configured kinetic-breach and infrastructure-attack indicators; risk holds 95/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Unattributed drone strike reportedly kills four suspected pirates after MV Lutuf hijacking
reports.text: Somali Guardian, citing Daily Somalia, reports an unattributed drone strike killed four suspected pirates after they went ashore following the MV Lutuf hijacking. The outlet says no government, coalition or contractor claimed responsibility and the vessel, crew and remaining hijackers’ status was undisclosed. The single-source claim is retained as a watch item and is not separately scored; risk holds 33/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: UN says 860,000 returned to southern Lebanon but fighting and mass displacement continue
reports.text: Official UN reporting says about 860,000 displaced people have returned, but 360,000 remain displaced and fighting continues despite the U.S.-brokered cessation framework. The report says weekend airstrikes caused new displacement; linked UN reporting counted 455 Israeli projectiles and 97 airspace breaches from Friday through Sunday. This reconfirms the active ceasefire-breach indicator; risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: IAEA chief reports several tons of nuclear material found at an undisclosed Syrian site
reports.text: Multiple public-news indexes quote IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi saying inspectors found several tons of nuclear material at an undisclosed Syrian site and that Damascus agreed the material would remain under Syrian control with IAEA safeguards. This is a major safeguards watch item, but the reporting does not establish a weapons programme, military use or a configured Syria/Idlib conflict indicator; risk holds 20/ELEVATED.
sources: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi via The Times of Israel

reports.headline: Israeli strike near Gaza City port kills six as ceasefire diplomacy remains unresolved
reports.text: Gaza health officials and multiple outlets reported six people killed in an Israeli strike near Gaza City port; the IDF said it targeted Hamas commanders planning attacks. The incident reconfirms the already-active configured ceasefire-breach indicator one day after Kushner-Netanyahu talks, but with risk already at the 95 ceiling it does not produce a further probability move.

reports.headline: Israel reports Hezbollah drone wounded three soldiers; IDF says it killed commanders in response
reports.text: The Long War Journal reports, citing the IDF, that a Hezbollah drone attack wounded three soldiers at Ali al-Taher and that Israeli strikes killed Hezbollah commanders in response. The claim reconfirms the already-active configured ceasefire-breach indicator; U.S.-Lebanese contacts keep diplomacy active and raw/coupled risk remains at the 95/100 ceiling.

reports.headline: Moscow threat to Britain hardens as London says Ukraine support remains firm
reports.text: Al Jazeera reports Russia’s London embassy warned of “consequences” over British-made drones used inside Russia, while UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said support for Ukraine would continue “100 percent”. A former Russian deputy foreign minister discussed possible attacks, but this was not a current Kremlin operational announcement. No official nuclear language, Article 4/5 action or direct Russia-NATO exchange occurred; Russia holds 70 raw / 80 coupled.

reports.headline: Yemeni government reports more than 100 operations in 24 hours as fighting spreads
reports.text: Al Jazeera directly reports Yemen’s internationally recognised government said its forces conducted more than 100 operations against Houthi positions in 24 hours, with clashes across multiple provinces and continued Houthi missile, drone and shipping attacks. The report reconfirms the already-active kinetic-breach, infrastructure-attack and force-expansion indicators; risk remains at the 95 ceiling.
sources: Yemen army spokesperson Col. Majed al-Nuzaili

reports.headline: Conflicting Hormuz traffic claims leave zero-traffic warning in force pending independent data
reports.text: Google News RSS indexed EnergyNow headlines saying Hormuz remained shut and, separately, that Iran claimed dozens of vessels were crossing. The conflicting headline-only reports do not independently establish restored normal traffic or justify deactivating hormuz_zero_traffic. OilPriceAPI still showed Brent near $91; Iran conventional risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Brent stays near $91 as Hormuz premium persists; no new threshold clears
reports.text: OilPriceAPI recorded front-month Brent at $90.97 (+2.23%/24h) and WTI at $84.18 (+2.86%/24h). BNY market commentary indexed by FXStreet continued to attribute elevated prices to the Hormuz conflict. The market move corroborates disruption but is not independent evidence of a fresh attack, deployment or closure event; Iran conventional risk holds at 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Multiple outlets corroborate four strikes on Abu al-Duhur military airfield
reports.text: The Jerusalem Post, Middle East Eye, Gulf News, TRT World, Anadolu and other public indexes now corroborate four air attacks on the inactive Abu al-Duhur military airfield in Idlib. Attribution remains disputed and no reliable casualty or damage assessment was available. This reconfirms the existing configured infrastructure-strike indicator; risk holds 20/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: Afghan envoy urges Pakistan dialogue as Kabul backs Chinese mediation
reports.text: Arab News Pakistan indexed an Afghan envoy urging dialogue and denying Afghan territory was used for attacks; TOLOnews and Kabul Tribune reported Kabul welcoming Chinese mediation. This activates the configured diplomacy indicator and lowers risk from 46% to 43%.

reports.headline: Four unidentified air strikes hit military airport in Idlib
reports.text: Middle East Eye, Gulf News, Mehr and additional public-news indexes reported four strikes on a military airport in Idlib. The attacker, aircraft and impact were not identified by cutoff. The crisis cleared the configured auto-detection threshold and opens at 20/ELEVATED with the configured infrastructure-strike indicator active.

reports.headline: Projectile strikes vessel in Hormuz; crew fatality reported
reports.text: UKMTO-linked reporting says an unknown projectile struck a vessel transiting out of the Strait of Hormuz, damaging the engine room and causing a crew fatality. The incident reconfirms the configured kinetic ceasefire breach; risk remains at the 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling.

reports.headline: Brent holds above $91 as Hormuz risk premium remains elevated
reports.text: OilPriceAPI recorded front-month Brent at $91.36 (+2.45%/24h) and WTI at $84.09 (+3.03%/24h). The move corroborates continued market concern around Hormuz but is not independent evidence of a new military threshold; Iran conventional risk remains 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: U.S. substantially reduces joint military exercises with South Korea
reports.text: BBC, ABC, NBC, the Guardian and Al Jazeera report the United States will substantially reduce joint exercises with South Korea, citing President Trump’s ties with Kim Jong Un. This is an allied-posture shift but no configured DPRK missile or nuclear-test indicator changed; risk holds 24/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: Regional states endorse combined anti-piracy task force for Gulf of Aden
reports.text: Marine News reports that Djibouti Code of Conduct/Jeddah Amendment states endorsed a combined task force for coordinated maritime operations and possible sea-riders. The underlying committee decisions were taken on 29 July and 5 August, and force composition and assets remain undecided; this is an allied-response watch item, not a fresh canonical signal or probability change.

reports.headline: Saudi Aramco resumes limited oil loadings from inside Hormuz
reports.text: Reuters reports, citing shipping data, that Saudi Aramco resumed oil loading from inside the Strait of Hormuz last week and had additional tankers waiting while offering spot heavy-crude cargoes. The evidence reinforces controlled, severely limited traffic rather than zero traffic; canonical hormuz_controlled_not_closed remains active and risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Russia warns Britain over reports UK-made drones struck inside Russia
reports.text: AFP via The Straits Times reports Russia’s London embassy said Britain would pay a higher “price” as its involvement deepens after reports that British-made drones were used against military and industrial targets inside Russia. The statement is escalatory but contains no nuclear language, Article 4/5 action or direct Russia-NATO exchange; no configured signal changes and raw/coupled risk holds 70/80.

reports.headline: Brent holds above $91 as Hormuz risk premium persists
reports.text: OilPriceAPI recorded front-month Brent at $91.10 (+2.69%/24h) and WTI at $84.12 (+3.24%/24h). The move corroborates market concern around Hormuz but is not independent evidence of a new military threshold; Iran conventional risk remains 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Erdogan urges Trump to pursue Iran talks and offers Turkish support
reports.text: Reuters reports President Erdogan urged President Trump by phone to pursue talks with Iran and offered Ankara’s support. Turkey said its foreign minister also discussed reopening Hormuz and continuing the ceasefire with Iran. This activates Turkey’s canonical diplomacy_active indicator, but the already-low Turkey regional-action risk holds at 5/DETERRENT.

reports.headline: U.S. rules out extending Iran ceasefire framework as Tehran renews offensive threat
reports.text: Reuters was indexed reporting that the United States ruled out extending the ceasefire framework while an Iranian official threatened a new offensive if no deal is reached within weeks. The item renews the already-assessed diplomatic deadlock but adds no independently verified operational move; risk remains 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Brent moves above $91 as Hormuz risk premium remains elevated
reports.text: OilPriceAPI recorded front-month Brent at $91.03 (+2.52%/24h) and WTI at $84.09 (+3.22%/24h). Energy strength corroborates market concern but does not establish a new military threshold; iran_conventional remains 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: UNIFIL records average 137 projectiles a day in southern Lebanon
reports.text: Al Jazeera reports UNIFIL recorded an average of 137 projectiles per day from 5-16 August, including 208 on Saturday and 185 on Sunday, despite the renewed ceasefire. The official monitoring reconfirms canonical ceasefire_violation; raw/coupled risk remains at the 95/100 ceiling while diplomacy_active also remains in force.

reports.headline: Eight armed people seize cargo vessel off Somalia near Mareeyo
reports.text: FTL Somalia directly reports, citing UKMTO, that eight armed people boarded and took control of a cargo vessel about four nautical miles south of Mareeyo. Lloyd's List separately indexed the Cameroon-flagged vessel as hijacked. This is a verified piracy escalation and raises the tracker from 28% to 33%; none of the configured indicators precisely matches a vessel seizure.

reports.headline: African Union delegation opens new Sudan ceasefire push
reports.text: Morning Star reports an African Union Peace and Security Council delegation began a two-day visit seeking a ceasefire, improved humanitarian access and revival of a political process. The concrete mission activates Sudan’s canonical diplomacy_active indicator, but there is no ceasefire implementation or verified battlefield reduction; risk holds at 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Trump says Kim Jong Un responded to his overtures
reports.text: Reuters was indexed reporting President Trump said Kim Jong Un had responded to his overtures. The fallback index did not expose the response's content, and no DPRK missile or nuclear test was reported. North Korea has no configured diplomacy signal; probability holds at 24%.

reports.headline: Brent rises above $90 as the Hormuz risk premium strengthens
reports.text: OilPriceAPI recorded front-month Brent at $90.59 (+2.11%/24h) and WTI at $83.34 (+1.67%/24h). The rise is consistent with a stronger Hormuz risk premium, but market prices are not independent evidence of a new military threshold; iran_conventional holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: U.S. general meets Lebanon's army chief as ceasefire remains under strain
reports.text: Google News RSS indexed Al-Monitor reporting that a U.S. general met Lebanon's army chief while the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire remained under strain. The article body was unavailable through the fallback path, so the item reconfirms active diplomacy but does not establish a new deployment or probability threshold.

reports.headline: UN rights chief alarmed by rising Yemen civilian toll and urges restraint
reports.text: Google News RSS indexed an official UN News report that UN human-rights chief Volker Türk was alarmed by Yemen’s rising civilian toll and urged restraint. This corroborates the worsening humanitarian context but does not by itself add a configured signal or change the 95/IMMINENT assessment.
sources: UN News via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Brent and WTI hold elevated as Hormuz risk premium persists
reports.text: OilPriceAPI recorded front-month Brent at $88.64 and WTI at $81.48. Elevated crude remains consistent with continuing Hormuz risk, but prices are not independent evidence of a new military threshold; iran_conventional holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Satellite investigation identifies 59 new Russian drone-launch rails near Ukraine and Belarus
reports.text: The Kyiv Independent, citing a Telegraph investigation based on satellite imagery, leaked documents and DroneSec analysis, reports 59 newly built launch rails across 10 sites. Seven sites were reportedly used in recent attacks on Kyiv; some could put Poland, Romania, the Baltic states and Turkey within drone range. The evidence activates canonical military_buildup for russia_ukraine; probability remains at the 99 ceiling. No direct attack on NATO was reported.

reports.headline: Iran says it is shifting to a fully offensive posture as Hormuz diplomacy stalls
reports.text: Reuters reports a senior Iranian official said Tehran had decided to shift from defensive to fully offensive policy and would be prepared for a timely military attack to break the U.S. naval blockade if diplomacy fails. The threat reinforces already-active diplomatic deadlock and Hormuz escalation signals; iran_conventional remains at 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Reported U.S.-Iran extension is disputed by Tehran as negotiation deadline lapses
reports.text: Al Arabiya reported that the 60-day period had been extended, but WANA and Iranian Foreign Ministry statements said the period covered negotiations rather than a ceasefire and that the framework was no longer relevant because talks never began. The contradictory reporting did not establish an active negotiation channel; refusal remained the controlling configured indicator pending authoritative joint confirmation.

reports.headline: Houthis claim missiles hit Saudi landing ship and escort boats off Mocha
reports.text: Times of India directly carried Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree’s claim that ballistic missiles hit a Saudi military landing ship and four escorts off Mocha, setting vessels ablaze or sinking them, alongside a drone strike on a Saudi-used weapons depot in Marib. Saudi authorities and independent sources had not confirmed damage or losses, so the claim reconfirms existing hostilities but is not separately scored.

reports.headline: Yemeni government fields near-daily drone operations as both sides expand aerial warfare
reports.text: Al Jazeera reports government units have begun operating reusable drones almost daily across multiple fronts after restructuring under a single decision-making centre, while Houthi forces retain more advanced long-range missile and drone capacity. The newly operational government capability activates canonical military_buildup and raises yemen_red_sea from 90 to 95/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Houthis launch two ballistic missiles toward Mocha and the Red Sea
reports.text: Arab Times directly verified Yemen's army report that the Houthis launched two ballistic missiles from Houthi-held territory toward Mocha and the Red Sea. The army reported no casualties or damage; the claim followed seven reported drone attacks on Mocha a day earlier. This reconfirms the ongoing canonical ceasefire_violation context without establishing a new configured threshold; risk holds 90/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Iranian drones target Iraqi Kurdistan prime minister’s office and intelligence chief’s home
reports.text: AFP via Khaleej Times reports that two Hadid-110 explosive-laden drones launched from across the Iranian border targeted Prime Minister Masrour Barzani’s private office and the regional intelligence chief’s home. Kurdish counter-terrorism authorities reported no casualties. The direct attack on senior-government premises raises risk from 48% to 53% and activates the configured infrastructure-attack indicator.

reports.headline: Reports say Israel prepares for extended Lebanon escalation as talks continue
reports.text: Google News RSS indexed The Arab Weekly and Yeni Safak reporting that Israeli forces were preparing for extended or days-long fighting in Lebanon while U.S.-led talks continued. The article bodies were unavailable through the fallback path, so the reports are retained as an unscored watch item and canonical military_buildup remains inactive; raw/coupled risk holds 95/100.

reports.headline: Trump says U.S. will substantially reduce joint drills with South Korea

reports.headline: Kushner arrives in Israel for Netanyahu talks after rare Hamas meeting
reports.text: BBC reports U.S. envoy Jared Kushner arrived in Israel and is expected to meet Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu after rare implementation talks with Hamas in Egypt. Eight Muslim-majority governments condemned Israel's rejection of the U.S.-backed plan; no official outcome has been released, Israel still conditions withdrawal on full Hamas disarmament, and strikes continue. reports.headline: Kpler records zero Hormuz commodity-vessel transits on Sunday after tanker attacks
reports.text: Reuters reports that Kpler ship-tracking data registered five commodity-vessel transits through the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday and none on Sunday, down from 31 over the prior weekend. Some vessels may pass with transponders off, so the evidence confirms the canonical hormuz_zero_traffic warning but not a complete legal closure. Iran conventional risk remains 95 raw / 100 coupled at the ceiling.

reports.headline: Iran-US Hormuz MoU deadline ends without reported resolution

reports.headline: Hamas expects direct Kushner meeting as Gaza diplomacy advances but strikes continue
reports.text: AFP, directly retrieved through ABS-CBN, reports Hamas sources expect to meet U.S. envoy Jared Kushner in Egypt with Egyptian and Qatari officials before he travels to Israel. Hamas political chief Khalil al-Hayya reaffirmed commitment to the Gaza plan in talks with Egypt's intelligence chief, while Israel carried out fresh strikes around Nuseirat and Khan Younis that reportedly caused injuries. This reconfirms the already-active the configured formal-talks and ceasefire-breach indicators; israel_palestine holds at 95/IMMINENT pending implementation.

reports.headline: Houthis launch new attacks on al-Makha and Marib as Yemen conflict escalates
reports.text: Al Jazeera reports a new overnight Houthi missile-and-drone wave against al-Makha and Marib killed four people and injured eight. Marib authorities said six ballistic missiles and four drones hit residential areas, while Yemen's military reported 181 operations against Houthi positions and renewed fighting across several provinces. reports.headline: Iran bounty threat against U.S. soldiers surfaces in public-news index

Iran conventional risk remains at the 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling, with no new canonical signal activated.

reports.headline: NATO says drone downed over Romania appears to be Russian
reports.text: Reuters and CNBC report that NATO SHAPE spokesperson Colonel Martin O'Donnell said the drone shot down by a Spanish F-18 over Romania appears to be Russian, while the investigation continues. Romania said the aircraft entered from Moldova. No casualties, Article 4/5 action or direct Russia-NATO exchange followed; no configured russia signal changes, and risk holds 70 raw / 80 coupled.

reports.headline: Ukraine launches mass drone barrage at Moscow as Russia strikes Kyiv
reports.text: Al Jazeera, citing AFP, Reuters and Russian and Ukrainian officials, reports Moscow was targeted by 600 Ukrainian drones and Russian authorities said 201 were destroyed in Moscow region. One person was killed near Moscow and three in Rostov; Russia simultaneously launched ballistic missiles at Kyiv and struck Kryvyi Rih. The reciprocal long-range campaign remains intense but crosses no newly configured signal, so russia_ukraine holds at 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: South Korea fires warning shots after North Korean soldiers cross demarcation line

reports.headline: NATO air-policing jet shoots down unidentified drone over Romania
reports.text: Al Jazeera, citing AFP, Reuters and Romania's Defence Ministry, reports a Spanish F-18 on NATO air-policing duty shot down a drone that illegally entered Romanian airspace. The ministry did not identify the drone's origin. This is Romania's fourth such interception this year, but the lack of attribution, injury, Article 4/5 action or direct Russia-NATO exchange leaves russia at 70 raw / 80 coupled and russia_ukraine at 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Israel carries out fresh southern Lebanon strikes as families flee north
reports.text: Al Jazeera reports Israeli airstrikes hit the Nabatieh district hours after the deadliest day of Israeli raids since the U.S.-brokered truce, when at least 11 people were killed. The new strikes reconfirm israel_lebanon ceasefire_violation, but raw/coupled risk remains at the 95/100 ceiling.

reports.headline: Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces counter new Houthi offensive
reports.text: Al Jazeera reports Saudi-backed government forces struck back after Houthi attacks intensified against government-held Marib and the strategic port of al-Makha. The reciprocal fighting reconfirms the existing kinetic-breach and infrastructure-attack warnings; it does not independently establish a new force buildup, and risk holds 90/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Senior Hamas delegation heads to Cairo for Gaza ceasefire talks
reports.text: TRT World and Anadolu report Hamas political chief Khalil al-Hayya led a senior delegation to Cairo for talks with Egypt's intelligence chief on consolidating the Gaza ceasefire and implementing its second phase. Israel and Hamas remain divided over withdrawal and disarmament, while daily lethal incidents continue. The concrete high-level negotiation activates the configured formal-talks offset alongside the ceasefire-breach indicator; israel_palestine eases 99→95 but remains IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Yemen says Houthi missiles and drones struck residential areas in Marib
reports.text: Al Jazeera reports Marib authorities said the Houthis hit the government-held city with four ballistic missiles and four drones, then launched two more ballistic missiles; several people were injured and homes, vehicles and other property were damaged. Al Jazeera verified aftermath video. The attacks renew the already-active canonical kinetic-breach and infrastructure_strike warnings, but yemen_red_sea holds at 90/IMMINENT because sustained multi-front escalation was already priced.

reports.headline: Morocco deploys army, navy and drones as 111 people are detained near Ceuta
reports.text: BBC, citing Moroccan security sources, Spanish media and Reuters, reports Morocco sent army officers, navy speedboats and drones to the Ceuta frontier after calls for a second mass crossing; Spain deployed more than 1,500 security officers. Authorities detained 111 people and used tear gas to disperse groups. Canonical military_buildup activates and spain_morocco_ceuta rises 22→27/CRITICAL; no armed interstate exchange was reported.

reports.headline: Ukraine strikes Russian rocket facility and air base with long-range weapons
reports.text: Al Jazeera and AP report Ukraine used Flamingo cruise missiles against a Roscosmos-linked rocket facility and also hit Savasleyka air base; Russian officials acknowledged industrial damage. Russia struck an apartment block in Ukraine, killing an infant. The fresh reciprocal attacks do not map to a newly configured signal; russia_ukraine holds at 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Israel confirms three soldiers wounded by explosive drone in southern Lebanon
reports.text: The Israeli military says three soldiers, including one officer, were wounded by an explosive drone in southern Lebanon overnight and evacuated for hospital treatment. Al Jazeera and Reuters separately report Israeli strikes killed 11 people in southern Lebanon. The reciprocal violence reconfirms canonical ceasefire_violation; probability remains at the 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling.

reports.headline: Israeli army says two Palestinians killed after crossing Gaza 'yellow line'
reports.text: The Israeli military says its Paratroopers Brigade killed two Palestinians who crossed the Gaza 'yellow line' and allegedly posed a threat. The fresh lethal incident reconfirms canonical kinetic-breach; israel_palestine remains at its 99/IMMINENT ceiling.

reports.headline: USS George H.W. Bush enters Arabian Sea as replacement for USS Abraham Lincoln
reports.text: U.S. Central Command posted images of the USS George H.W. Bush in the Arabian Sea. reports.text: South Korea's National Intelligence Service told lawmakers that a U.S.-North Korea summit should be viewed as possible at any time, while stressing that no concrete contact has been presented. South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff separately said the September 9-11 Freedom Edge exercise with the United States and Japan remains on schedule despite North Korean criticism. reports.text: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Washington would use further kinetic strikes if needed and was not ruling out action around Iran or the Strait of Hormuz. He also confirmed the USS Abraham Lincoln is returning home after an extended deployment. The official language sustains extreme conventional-war risk, while the carrier return is a limited offset; neither changes a configured indicator. Iran conventional holds 100/IMMINENT.

The official statement confirms the scale of the piracy surge but announces no new operational deployment or separate infrastructure event. Somalia / Gulf of Aden holds 38/CRITICAL.
